why_structurally: The walker's import block hits hard ImportError on bumped transformers versions (v4_55_4 / v5_9_0) when symbols renamed in `tokenizers` or `huggingface_hub`. The crash IS the brittleness signal during the trial (Phase 3a.2 data) - but defensive `try ... except ImportError` would let the walker emit zero invariants gracefully instead of crashing the miner subprocess.
proposed_fix_summary: Wrap the most-fragile imports in try/except blocks that fall back to lightweight stubs so the AST walk can still proceed against the bumped source.
